rationale: Record a plug-in editor host change that crosses the render-assets-and-backends family through its broad core/view selector. A plug-in may declare its editor background (Processor::editor_background); every plug-in host paints that colour, instead of the fixed framework default, on its backing layer before the first frame, under the tree before a view-first document mounts, and in the letterbox bars around a pinned design viewport. An undeclared plug-in resolves to its root theme's bg.primary, which for the default dark theme is the old default, so existing editors paint as before. No importer, DesignIR, capture path, render backend selection, asset, codegen output, fixture or threshold changes. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
